label: <DEL> step when the sequence starts with u (rare subset)
explanation: Extremely sparse (40 of 1M sequences). Every activation is at the delimiter step (t == L, about to output orig(0)) of a sequence whose first original token is u. It never fires in the original or copy phases, or on other first tokens. It fires on only about 0.1% of u-initial delimiter steps, so precision is very low. Activations are larger when the sequence also contains f and the last original token (prev_tok) is m/p/r/o, with L of 5 to 9 (peak at L=6). That conjunction reaches dev mass recall 0.82 at precision 0.04, which suggests a narrow combinatorial context that the available variables cannot isolate.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 10 cues. Raise it: phase=1 & out_tok=u (+4.27), prev_tok=m (+1.93), orig3=f (+1.60), orig4=p (+1.49), orig2=f (+1.19), next_out=u (+1.10). Lower it: in_count=1 (-2.41).
